claims.text: Merged implementation authority: PR ggml-org/llama.cpp#27742 (Unsloth-authored danielhanchen, merged 2026-08-27 by ngxson, 65 commits) adds qwen4exp arch: converter, GDN text graph with low-rank hyper-connections, MoE 512-expert top-10, QSA sparse attention (budget 2048, ratio 4), host-side PLE n-gram hash (97.7GiB table, 128 shards, splitmix64 2^45 host hashing), stock Qwen3-VL ViT path.
claims.context: PR page fully consumed this pass (conversation + commit messages).

claims.text: Validation method: wikitext-2 ppl 4.0068 vs 4.0126 reference, 98.0% top-1 prose agreement, QSA-vs-dense bit-identical below budget with 0.975 mean jaccard above, PLE row indices 1024/1024, chunked-prefill bit-identity, test-llama-archs 126 archs green.
claims.context: PR-reported validation; fixture-bound as stated on-PR.

claims.text: Known implementation gaps documented: PLE conv state across ubatches fixed in-PR with bit-identity proof; test-llama-archs qwen4exp skip resolved (saver uint64 path + key re-emission); quantized-model (UD-IQ1_S) logit delta 2.84e-03 non-identical; shared-file changes additive-only with A/B md5s.
claims.context: Gap transparency per PR discussion; AI-usage disclosure (Claude + local models, manual verification) noted.
